scores.evidence: The 3 can-do objectives each have 2 or more graded questions, and each has one at apply level or higher (o1: q4 apply, e1 analyze, e2 apply; o2: q2, q3, e3 evaluate; o3: q5, e6 apply). One gap holds this at 3. o1 lists 「CLAUDE.md・.claude/rules/・CLAUDE.local.md・権限ルール」, but e2 tests a hook (answer 「フックで自動的に実行させる」) and e1 tests when AGENTS.md is read. Only q4 tests a choice among the places o1 names.

hook-b1 sets a concrete scene in 3 sentences: the repeated 「テストは `npm run test:unit` で」 and the senior's 300-line CLAUDE.md with 「`.env` は絶対に読まない」. It closes on the prediction 「`.env` の読み取りをどう止めるか、予想してみましょう」. q0 is an ungraded predict item on o3, and its explanation points ahead to 6-4. There is no trivia or statistic.

The prerequisites give the titles of 第1回 to 第5回, and the lesson recalls them where they are needed (「第1回と第5回で見たとおり」 in s1-lead, 「第2回で書いた、ツールの使用を…」 in s4-defs). Terms are defined before use, with English on first use. The changed glossary セッション entry (「`claude` を起動すると始まる、ひと続きの会話。始めるたびに、まっさらなコンテキストから始まります。」) matches cc-01 and cc-05 and agrees with s1-lead and with the feedback on e6 option a.

measure.mjs reports 「prose 2399 (budget 1,200–2,400) · questions 9 · est 19.3 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」, and lint --strict finds 0 warnings. Each segment has 3 or fewer new terms. Two things hold this at 3. s3 packs 3 new terms, a code block, a diagram, a callout and a check into one segment. And 自動メモリ（auto memory） is defined in s1-defs, but no later block or question uses it.

s5-steps is a complete worked example that comes before practice. Its 6 steps have subgoal labels (「① コードからわかる行を消す」 to 「⑥ 自分だけの好みをローカルへ移す」), each with a reason in md and a result in expect (「チームのCLAUDE.mdは2行になります」). No faded example sits between it and the independent 19-line practice.

Each of s1 to s4 ends with an inline check, and every wrong option has feedback. In q2 the learner repairs a conflict, in q3 judges which line can go, and in q4 places a 10-line rule set. q5 can still be answered by recognition: its answer 「CLAUDE.mdは判断の材料として読まれ、強制はされないから」 restates s4-lead 「参考に判断しますが、必ず守るという保証はありません」, which the learner has just read.

Every misconception in the brief appears as a distractor, with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer: override vs concatenation (q2 b, e1 a), `@` reducing context (q4 c, e3 a), length or the 200-line limit as a guarantee (q5 b, e6 b), 「覚えている」 (e6 a) and auto mode (e6 d). But 「IMPORTANT」 is a wrong answer in 5 of the 9 items (q0 a, q2 a, q5 a, e2 a, e3 c), so a learner can rule it out by pattern.

s3-diagram is a model: 5 nodes, labels in the text's own terms, alt text and a caption that states the takeaway (「減らせるのは paths: 付きのルールです」). But the column-1 labels of s1-table clash with its caption 「（広い順）」. 「どこでも」 comes after 「組織全体」 yet sounds broader, and 「ここだけ」 vs 「チーム」 mixes where with who.

The task is authentic and asks for near transfer. The 19-line file adds new cases: 「編集したら毎回必ず npm run format」 becomes a hook candidate, and two test lines are combined. There is a 3-level hint ladder (the pr-decide hint, its troubleshoot, then practice-hint3), a 7-item checklist and a model answer (practice-answer plus practice-answer-settings). practice-hint3 matches the answer, and highlight 6–12 covers the 4 kept items and the HTML comment that practice-answer-why explains.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next asks a reflection question (「ここ1週間で、Claudeに2回以上した同じ説明や直しはありますか」) and names the next lesson by its title. summary-cards has 7 cards, and summary-ask offers 3 tutor prompts.

All 5 confirmed findings in audit-cc-06-claude-md.json are fixed in the current text. The 「既定では、作業フォルダーとその上に…」 qualifier is in s3-defs, the AGENTS.md glossary entry and card-agents, and the cat/head condition is in q4 and card-paths. The limits of deny rules match items 3–4 of cross-lesson-facts.md (「`git -C . push`」 in s4-close). The claims I checked against facts-cc-06-claude-md.md hold: 200 lines or 25KB for MEMORY.md, import nesting up to 4 levels, edits applying after /clear, /compact or a restart, HTML comments stripped, and 5 anti-patterns in the blog. The version is pinned (「Claude Code v2.1.304」).

Learner-facing text keeps です・ます and a warm tone (「まず…予想してみましょう」, 「迷ったら…確かめましょう」). The plain-form lines in practice-setup (a sample file) and the casual replies in e6 (a colleague speaking) are deliberate voices. lint --strict finds no banned phrase or over-long sentence. Wording is left to the ja-editor.
The jp locale is complete, diagram labels included. The alt text of s3-diagram describes exactly what is drawn, and the diagram has a caption. The link text says where it leads (「公式ドキュメント（日本語）」).

niceToHave: check-quiz e2 option a: 「IMPORTANT」 is a wrong answer in 5 of the 9 items, so learners can rule it out by pattern (miscon). Replace e2 a md with 「CLAUDE.mdに「編集したら必ず整形する」と書く」. Keep its feedback (「Claudeが整形を選んで実行するのと、整形が自動で走るのは別のことです。…」), which already names this misconception.
s4-check q5 option c: the answer restates s4-lead (active). Replace its md with 「CLAUDE.mdの行は、Claude Codeが操作を止める設定ではないから」.

s1-table: the caption says 「（広い順）」, but 「どこでも」 comes after 「組織全体」 and reads as broader (visual). Replace the caption with 「CLAUDE.mdの4つの置き場所と届く範囲（読まれる順）」, or replace row 2 col 1 with 「自分全般」 (the ja-editor confirms the wording).

objectives o1: e2 assesses choosing a hook, which o1 does not list (align). Change the o1 text to 「指示の置き場所（CLAUDE.md・.claude/rules/・CLAUDE.local.md・権限ルール・フック）を、内容に合わせて選べる」. Changing an objective forces a full review in the next round.

check-quiz e6 option a: s1-defs teaches auto memory but nothing uses it later (load). Replace md with 「「Claudeが自動メモリにも書いたから、もう確実だよ」」 and its feedback with 「自動メモリもCLAUDE.mdと同じく、読まれる頼みごとです。止めたい操作は、拒否ルールやフックで決めておきます。」. This also fits the scenario better, since the colleague wrote the rule in a file, not in a chat.

factual doubt: s4-table cites only steering-post, but its row 「禁止」→「権限ルールの拒否ルール（deny、第2回）」 may be the lesson's own mapping. facts-cc-06-claude-md.md quotes the blog as 'Put guardrails in hooks', and the memory docs as 'use a PreToolUse hook'. Check the blog. If it names hooks, not deny rules, add "cc-permissions" to the s4-table cite.
Budget guard: prose is at 2399 of the 2,400 cap (measure.mjs). Offset any text a fix adds with an equal cut.
summary: Full review of the current text, as the review gate requires. The task said the author made changes aimed at criteria scored 3. In fact, the only change since the previous round (0913750984346c84) is the glossary entry セッション, now 「`claude` を起動すると始まる、ひと続きの会話」, which matches cc-01 and cc-05. So every criterion that scored 3 is still at 3 for the same unchanged reasons. All criteria score 3 or more, the mean is 3.46 and there is no must-fix item. validate and lint --strict are clean, and measure.mjs gives an estimate of 19.3 min with prose at 2399 of 2400. The strengths are the 6-step worked example, the practice with its 3-level hint ladder, checklist and model answer, and accuracy, with all 5 audit findings fixed. To raise the scores at 3: replace 「IMPORTANT」 as the answer to rule out in e2, reword q5 c, and fix the s1-table labels.
